newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Credito cuts prime rate 75 bps.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Credito cuts prime rate 75 bps.

text.p: Italy's Credito Italiano said on Thursday it was cutting its prime rate 75 basis points to 10.0 percent, effective today.
The move followed a reduction on Wednesday of the Bank of Italy's discount rate by 75 basis points to 7.50 percent from 8.25 percent.
The bank said its top rate for clients remained at 18.25.

Other banks, including Monte dei Paschi di Siena, Cassa di Risparmio di Verona, Vicenza, Belluno e Ancona Banca Spa and Ambroveneto also announced cuts in their prime rate following the Bank of Italy's easing.
